column1: # Ratchet-down-only: lowering a MAX is routine maintenance; raising ANY value
# requires explicit justification in the PR that edits it.
#   lines <src/FILE|zxfer|TOTAL> MAX -- max wc -l line count
#   functions <src/FILE|zxfer|TOTAL> MAX -- max top-level function definitions
#   callers SYMBOL MAX [ALLOWED_FILES] -- max grep -rnF match lines for the
#     literal SYMBOL across src/ + zxfer; the optional comma-separated
#     ALLOWED_FILES list pins which files may contain matches at all.
# zxfer_cleanup_child_wrapper.sh grew by the Phase 5 ps -A fix comment (the
# descendant reaper must list every process, not just same-terminal ones);
# the runner-module deletion pays for it many times over in the TOTAL row.
# and zxfer_runtime.sh rose slightly when the Phase 6 adversarial review
# landed safety fixes: the deferred corrupt-metadata reap recheck in error-log
# lock acquisition, the held unsafe-TMPDIR fallback advisory replayed after
# option parsing, main-shell start-token memoization comments, and the
# randomized staging-name helper for shared sticky parents. The TOTAL row
# still sits ~1,200 lines below the pre-Phase 6 baseline.
# survivors (serialize/decode, prefetch, in-memory property tables) when the
# per-dataset file cache was deleted; the TOTAL row still ratchets down.
# zxfer_snapshot_reconcile.sh grew by the Phase 4 generation-gated live
# invalidate helper plus its loop call site, and the destroy-site generation
# bump with its comment); the rise is paid for by deleting dead discovery
# refine/diff helpers, so the TOTAL row still ratchets down.
# zxfer_path_security.sh gained the shared randomized staging-name helper
# held unsafe-TMPDIR advisory emitter; both are adversarial-review safety
# fixes for Phase 6 and the functions TOTAL still ratchets down against the
# zxfer_invalidate_live_destination_view helper; the functions TOTAL still
# ratchets down against the pre-Phase 4 baseline.
# mktemp callers after Phase 6 are the single per-run temp-root allocation in
